builtinSectionHint: Built-in shape rules can only be toggled, not deleted, and are grouped by scenario for quick decisions. Public IP, IPv6, and Hong Kong China ID are off by default to avoid over-masking.
groupCoreHint: Phone numbers, emails, IDs and connection strings — the shapes that leak most often.
groupCredentialsHint: Cloud access keys, client secrets and tokens assigned as key=value.
groupEntitiesHint: License plates, unified social credit codes, IBAN and similar.
groupNetworkHint: IP and MAC address shapes; over-masking hides network configuration from the model.
groupNetworkTitle: Network and device identifiers (optional, may affect model config reasoning)
plugin.description: Detects and masks sensitive credentials in the Router request path, injects placeholder integrity constraints for the model, and restores the original values on the response path.
plugin.lifecycle: Can be disabled: disabling only stops detecting and replacing newly sent plaintext. Credential references issued in past sessions are still recognised, still receive the integrity instruction, and are still restored in responses. After disabling, new requests may carry unprocessed credential plaintext.
plugin.name: Credential Protection
prefixSectionHint: Configure prefixes for API keys and tokens such as sk-, ghp_, hf_. Values written with these prefixes are captured by the API_KEY rule. Commas and underscores (_) are equivalent; @ may sit anywhere. Up to 8 characters after the prefix are replaced.
protectionBody: When disabled, newly sent plaintext is no longer detected or replaced.
protectionKeepsBody: Credential references issued in past sessions are still recognised, still receive the integrity instruction, and are still restored in responses.
protectionRiskBody: Newly sent requests may contain unprocessed credential plaintext sent straight to the Provider.
